listing.name: Drakengard 3 — Drakengard3Recompile (k1gs) (k1gs)
listing.summary: Experimental Drakengard 3 source project. Upstream reports the intro, audio, title and main menu; gameplay with working controls has not been confirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own decrypted PlayStation Network NPUB31251 game files, version 1.01.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream instructions to generate the game code and build from source.

warnings: Upstream reports the intro, audio, title and main menu. Gameplay with working controls has not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
